intent_snapshot.goal: Keep one rebuildable work item per Loop target with the D5 state machine, route ready-for-agent Issues without a plan to planning, and judge level events only when their fact fingerprint changed, per D5 of docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. No user-visible change: the state lives in .imm/state/loop/.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-1, BR-GAP-A1; meet D5 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-work-items.test.ts over tick with fake ports. Done looks like: a ready-for-agent Issue with no published plan moves to planning and never selects enroll_and_drive; with a published plan the label counts as approval. Negative: a handler result that would make an illegal transition is refused and recorded. Bound: an empty state directory is rebuilt from GitHub and Kernel fixtures before scheduling.

Source BR-GAP-4; meet D5 fingerprint bullet in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-work-items.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-judge.test.ts. Done looks like: a level event (E5, E6, E8, E9, E11) whose fact changed is judged once. Negative: the same unchanged level fact across two ticks writes no second decision. Bound: edge events still deduplicate by event_id.

attestations.summary: Provenance checked: review commit c2583dfa has the single parent 1e6d3308 and tree 75d5a5c4, and each antigravity mirror has the same blob OID as its immune-brain file. S5-AC1 holds: the readyTask matcher in judgement.ts sends ready-for-agent without a published plan to draft_plan and with a plan to enroll_and_drive. advanceWorkItem refuses and records illegal transitions, and ensureWorkItems rebuilds an empty store from snapshot plus .imm/runs before judging. S5-AC2 holds: selectUnjudgedEvents gives E5/E6/E8/E9/E11 a fact fingerprint without timestamp or event_id, and edge events still deduplicate by event_id. The tests at the agreed seams (loop-sched-work-items.test.ts tick, loop-daemon-judge.test.ts) cover the positive, negative and bound cases. Blast radius medium: loop_daemon/cli.ts tick path and judgement.ts Tier-1 routing, plus a new persisted shape .imm/state/loop/work_items/<target>.json (assurance_kernel/loop_work_item/v1).

advisory_findings.summary: recordJudgedEvents saves level-event fingerprints before dispatch runs. If dispatch defers a judged level decision (budget or lease), the event is not judged again until its fact changes; this is safe only if reconcileSkippedDecisions re-drives skipped decisions, which this review did not check.

evidence.trigger: An E5_READY_TASK is judged draft_plan, then dispatch skips it because the budget is exhausted, and the next tick sees the same fact. Expected: the event is retried. Observed: selectUnjudgedEvents drops it, so the issue may wait until some fact changes.

advisory_findings.summary: Each edge event adds a permanent last_judged entry keyed by event_id, so a work item file grows without bound over a long-lived target.

evidence.trigger: An issue gets many E3 owner comments or E2 edits over months. Expected: the file stays small. Observed: every event_id stays in last_judged forever, so the file grows on every tick that reads or writes it.
